title: Pulsating High Freq Observer
text: Estimate initial rotor electrical position of interior PMSM using pulsating high frequency (PHF) injection, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Datatype} sets Input and output data type; {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Input units} sets the unit of block, {Compute PHF parameters automatically using motor parameters} sets the automatically compute PHF parameters, {Compute DP parameters automatically using motor parameters} sets the automatically compute DP parameters, {Stator resistance (ohm)} sets the motor resistance, {Stator d-axis inductance (H)} sets the motor inductance, {Stator q-axis inductance (H)} sets the motor inductance, {Base voltage (V)} sets the rated voltage, {Base current (A)} sets the rated current, {Compute PHF parameters}, {Compute DP parameters}, {PHF peak voltage (PU)} sets the peak voltage of PHF, {PHF frequency (Hz)} sets the pHF voltage frequency, {LP filter cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the cutoff frequency for lowpass filter of PHF, {Select tuning parameters} selects control parameters for manual tuning Controller, {Proportional gain}, {Integral gain}, {Expected settling time (s)} sets the expected settling time of estimated, {Expected damping ratio}, {Compute Control Parameters} sets the compute disabled control, {Open loop duration (s)} sets the duration of open-loop PHF injection during stage 1 part, {Closed loop duration (s)} sets the duration of closed-loop PHF injection during stage 1 part, {Idle time (s)} sets the duration between algorithm steps, {Error threshold (rad)} sets the minimum error threshold for θ, {Pulse voltage (PU)} sets the amplitude of injected pulses and {Pulse duration (s)} sets the duration of injected pulses. Values come from the instance.
